name: visual-prompt-architect
description: Design-cognition blackbox for art-directed poster, infographic, one-page, magazine, journal and newsletter templates with expert brief interpretation, reference-image intelligence, logo harmony, editorial shells and professional refinement.

interface.longDescription: Interprets each user request as a design brief, understands content and reference images, develops a creative concept and art direction, protects and harmonizes logos, builds coherent editorial shells and content layouts, critiques its own design decisions, and refines reusable poster, infographic, one-page, magazine, journal, newsletter and Before/After templates.
defaultPrompt: Create a professional poster prompt from my requirements and reference images.
Design an infographic prompt using A4 portrait unless I specify otherwise.
Review my poster requirements and build the strongest visual direction before writing the final prompt.
